clues: Yusuf hauled more traps than Nico.
Whoever had the orange buoys hauled neither 20 traps nor 50 traps.
The herring skipper's buoys were lime.
Arlo hauled more traps than whoever baited with squid.
Of Arlo and Yusuf, one baited with pogies and the other hauled 30 traps.
Between the pogies skipper and the squid skipper, one hauled 40 traps and the other hauled 50.
Whoever baited with pogies did not have white buoys.
hints: Look at clue 7. The pogies and squid skippers hauled 40 and 50 traps between them. Which clue tells you which way round?
Comparisons rule out the ends, and clue 5 is a comparison. Which end can the squid skipper never reach? Put that with clue 7.
Squid cannot be 50, so by clue 7 squid hauled 40 and pogies 50. Arlo hauled more than squid's 40, so Arlo hauled 50 with pogies.
With Arlo on pogies, clue 6 gives Yusuf the 30 traps. Clue 2 leaves Nico only 20, so Greta hauled 40 with the squid.

solution.key_idea: Clue 5 keeps squid off 50 traps, so by clue 7 squid hauled 40 and pogies 50, and those 50 traps are Arlo's.
steps: By clue 5, Arlo hauled more than the squid skipper, so squid was not 50 traps. Clue 7 then gives squid 40 and pogies 50.
Arlo hauled more than squid's 40, so Arlo hauled 50 traps and baited with pogies.
Clue 8 rules out white for pogies, clue 3 rules out orange at 50 traps, and clue 4 gives lime to herring. So Arlo had purple buoys.
Clue 6 then gives Yusuf the 30 traps. By clue 2, Nico hauled fewer than Yusuf, so Nico hauled 20 and Greta 40.
Squid hauled 40, so Greta baited with squid. Clue 1 rules out herring for Nico, so Nico used redfish and Yusuf herring.
By clue 4, Yusuf had lime buoys. Clue 3 keeps orange off Nico's 20 traps, so Greta had orange and Nico white.
solution.epilogue: The co-op's tally sheet read Arlo 50, Greta 40, Yusuf 30 and Nico 20. Nico's count was the smallest, he admitted, but his lobster had reached the size of a rowboat.
